# The 20 roles

Every role is a Claude Code session with its own name, model, effort, inbox and status file. The id (left) is
what the scripts and plan files use; a [theme](themes.md) only changes the character name, colour and voice you see.
A plan starts a role in a pane, starts it lazily when a brief lands, or only on demand; a dash means the
plan does not include it.

| | Role | Label | Job | Pro | Max 5x | Max 20x |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/relay.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Relay** | Relay | You are the one session the user talks to. Your context stays small because you do no work yourself. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/dispatcher.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Dispatcher** | Dispatcher | You take the relay's briefs, split them, and hand each piece to the cheapest worker that can do it. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/architect.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Architect** | Architect | You decide the hard questions: designs, RFC-level trade-offs and anything the other roles could get wrong in a way that is costly to undo. You are on demand: started for one brief, not kept running. | on demand | on demand | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/builderheavy.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **BuilderHeavy** | Builder | You take the hardest builds and the bugs nobody has explained yet. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/builderprecise.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **BuilderPrecise** | Builder | You implement briefs that are already specified: the files, the change and the check are named. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/reviewer.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Reviewer** | Reviewer | You read the diff of every `.done` and say whether it holds. | on demand | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/writer.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Writer** | Writer | You write what people read: docs, decision files, question cards and the board. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/runner.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Runner** | Runner | You run tests and commands for the other roles and report what happened, exactly. | - | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/scribe.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Scribe** | Scribe | You record decisions faithfully, and nothing else. `DECISIONS.md` is yours (see the file table in `CLAUDE.md`). | - | - | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/backendcritic.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **BackendCritic** | Backend critic | You try to break the backend side of a change at the gate. You never fix anything. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/frontendcritic.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **FrontendCritic** | Frontend critic | You try to break the frontend side of a change at the gate. You never fix anything. | - | on demand | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/securitycritic.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **SecurityCritic** | Security critic | You try to break a change the way an attacker would. You never fix anything. | - | on demand | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/scopecritic.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **ScopeCritic** | Scope critic | You ask whether the change is what was asked, no more and no less. You never fix anything. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/blindreviewer.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **BlindReviewer** | Blind reviewer | You review the diff with no brief and no context, on purpose. You judge only what the code says. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/keeper.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Keeper** | Keeper of record | You keep the long-lived record of the project true: what the system is, and how it came to be that way. You never edit code. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/observer.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Observer** | Observer | You watch the whole board and touch nothing. | - | - | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/housekeeper.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Housekeeper** | Housekeeper | You keep the workspace tidy: old worktrees, stale branches, finished inbox files. You never delete without a brief. | - | - | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/tutor.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Tutor** | Tutor | You explain to the human and guide the other roles. You do no work yourself. On demand only. | - | - | on demand |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/watcher.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Watcher** | Post-merge watcher | You stay up after a fold and watch for what breaks. On demand: started after a merge, not kept running. | - | - | on demand |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/plain/coach.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Coach** | Agent coach | You turn mistakes into rules so the team does not pay for the same one twice. On demand only; silent otherwise. | - | - | on demand |

Each role's full card is in `template/impl/protocol/<Id>.md`.
